card.name: Table cells just before a new row
card.fires_on: The spot where one table cell ends and the next begins, often the start of 'Ac' in 'Acute' after a duration column in dosing tables. It also fires on a few other break points such as '(' after a hormone name or a multiplication sign in needle sizes.
